summary: News Corp filed an 8-K Item 8.01 disclosure of daily ASX repurchase data under its existing stock buyback program, which authorizes up to $1B in aggregate of Class A and Class B common stock. The filing describes no specific per-share price or premium; it is a routine update of transactions conducted under the program. The company does not name an advisor. The program remains ongoing with no stated expiration; repurchases are made from time to time subject to market conditions and legal requirements. Watch for continued repurchase activity and impact on share count.
